reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens reference palette tokens instead of literal values.
reguloj.kialo: A palette change then reaches every semantic use in one place.

reguloj.name: surface-order
reguloj.statement: In every combination, the OKLCH lightness of color.background.sunken ≤ canvas ≤ default ≤ raised.
reguloj.kialo: The surface hierarchy carries spatial meaning; a break is visible to users and to no contrast check.

reguloj.name: text-hierarchy
reguloj.statement: In every combination, color.text.default, .subtle and .muted resolve to pairwise different colours, neighbouring roles differ by at least 0.05 in OKLCH lightness, and their contrast against color.background.default does not rise from default to muted.
reguloj.kialo: The text roles carry a distinction of meaning; high contrast must not erase it.

reguloj.name: state-distinct
reguloj.statement: In every combination, the OKLCH lightness of color.action.<v>.hover, .pressed and .selected differs from .rest by at least 0.05.
reguloj.kialo: A state that looks like the rest state gives no feedback.

reguloj.name: semantic-described
reguloj.statement: Every role token in core has a $description that states its use.
reguloj.kialo: Agents read values from token files but not the purpose.

reguloj.name: contrast-reserve
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, every KontrastParo exceeds the WCAG 2.x threshold that binds it by at least the sojlo; the branch that carries the result is the one measured.
reguloj.kialo: Meeting a threshold exactly means missing it on the next screen: font smoothing, a cheap panel, a translucent edge or a rounded value all cost a few percent. A reserve makes the promise hold outside the calculation, and it is the difference between a value that passes a test and a value that works.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: every KontrastParo in every combination

reguloj.name: surface-distinct
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, neighbouring surface roles (sunken, canvas, default, raised) differ in OKLCH lightness by at least the sojlo.
reguloj.kialo: If two surfaces share a lightness, only the shadow carries the layering — and the shadow is gone in high contrast, in forced colours, in print and on a screenshot. A layer that exists in the model must be visible in the value, not only in an effect.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.background.sunken, canvas, default, raised in every combination
